description: The `mova` binary: `mova modules ...` dispatches to mova_modules::main_args, `mova fetch ...` to mova_modules::fetch::main_args, `mova oewn ...` to mova_modules::oewn::main_args; errors print the chain and exit 1.
forward: Arguments after the program name; modules -> main_args(rest); fetch -> fetch::main_args(rest); oewn -> oewn::main_args(rest); otherwise usage error; error -> stderr and exit 1.
inverse: Behavior complement: no option parsing, configuration or subcommands other than modules, fetch and oewn.
Reverse reconstruction: exit status gives only success or failure; stderr carries the failing step.
limitations: Thin adapter; behaviour lives in mova-modules-lib, mova-modules-fetch and mova-modules-oewn.
